findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_accommodations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Searches and compares multiple hotels in a city, neighborhood, airport, landmark, or other destination. Every search requires both checkinDate and checkoutDate,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_accommodations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
